ERROR_INVALID_LEFT_IMPLICATION.en: ^, Formula {formula} (conclusion of the rule) must be the antecedent of the implication of the referenced formula with truth-value F.

ERROR_INVALID_RIGHT_IMPLICATION.pt: ^, A fórmula {formula} (conclusão da regra) deve ser o consequente da implicação da fórmula referenciada com valor-verdade T.

ERROR_INVALID_LEFT_RIGHT_IMPLICATION.en: ^, Formula {formula} (conclusion of the rule) must be the antecedent or consequent of the implication of the referenced formula.

ERROR_INVALID_LEFT_CONJUNCTION.en: ^, Formula on the left formula of the conclusion is not proof by any of the lines referenced in this rule.

ERROR_INVALID_RIGHT_CONJUNCTION.en: ^, Formula on the right formula of the conclusion is not proof by any of the lines referenced in this rule.
